column4: Pixel-art game sprite in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage): chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette, strong simple shading, seen straight from the front at eye height, as one flat cut-out layer of things standing side by side on one floor line along the bottom edge, warm lamp light on them. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere else, also between and above the things; no walls, no floor, no ceiling drawn, no shadow, no text, no border, no watermark. The furniture of a small wooden 1980s Czech holiday cabin room: on the left a single wooden bed with a red checked blanket and a white pillow, in the middle a small wooden table with a glowing table lamp and a mug on it and a wooden chair beside it, on the right a narrow wardrobe with a coat hanging on its door.
